description: This file is a shell script used for testing shared repository initialization in Git. It contains multiple test cases and setup routines for validating different configurations and permissions related to Git repositories.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to succeed, with a descriptive message.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets commands to run after the test finishes for cleanup.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Marks a command that is expected to fail.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets a configuration value for the test environment.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Verifies that a specific path does not exist.

methods.name: test_modebits
methods.description: Retrieves and tests file permissions mode bits.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal clock for testing purposes.
